children: Global professional services company Jacobs Solutions
will be announcing earnings results this Monday after market hours. Here’s what investors should know.

Jacobs Solutions beat analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $2.42 billion, up 8.3% year on year. It was a mixed quarter for the company, with full-year EPS guidance in line with analysts’ estimates.
Is Jacobs Solutions a buy or sell going into earnings?

params.linkText: Read our full analysis here, it’s free for active Edge members

children: This quarter, the market is expecting Jacobs Solutions’s revenue to grow 13.9% year on year, improving from the 5.8% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.

Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings. Jacobs Solutions has missed Wall Street’s revenue estimates multiple times over the last two years.

Looking at Jacobs Solutions’s peers in the government & technical consulting segment, some have already reported their Q3 results, giving us a hint as to what we can expect. Booz Allen Hamilton’s revenues decreased 3.9% year on year, missing analysts’ expectations by 1.1%, and Maximus reported a revenue decline of 1.3%, in line with consensus estimates. Booz Allen Hamilton traded up 6.1% following the results while Maximus was down 3.8%.

Over the last year or so, investors' attention has moved from one major market theme to the next, spanning AI disruption and surging infrastructure investment to geopolitical tensions, interest rates, and the health of the broader economy. While some of the government & technical consulting stocks have shown solid performance in this choppy environment, the group has generally underperformed, with share prices down 9.5% on average over the last month. Jacobs Solutions is up 6.1% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $162.80 (compared to the current share price of $153.91).
